title: Madhya Pradesh MPESB Van Rakshak & Kshetra Rakshak Karyapalik Van Vibhag, Jail Prahari Karyapalik Jail Vibhag and Jail Superintend Admit Card 2026 Out for 2062 Post
intro: Madhy Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has Officially Released Admit Card for the Post of Forester Van Rakshak & Kshetra Rakshak (Karyapalik) (Van Vibhag), Jail Prahari (Karyapalik) (Jail Vibhag) and Jail Superintend Combined Recruitment Test 2026 for 2062 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to MPESB Jobs. Re-Exam Start on June 20, 2026  & Admit Card Released On June 8, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Admit Card Now in the Given Link Below.
